title: Producer-Consumer
description: A producer reads tweets from a mock stream and a consumer filters them. Make producer and consumer run concurrently (add a channel, about 6 lines).
task: Change the code so the producer and the consumer run concurrently — the consumer should process each tweet as soon as the producer reads it.
hints: Both producer and consumer must be in their own goroutine.
A single buffered channel can bridge the two.
Run producer and consumer side by side; the whole pipeline should take about max(5*320ms, 5*330ms).
starterFails: starter.go runs producer fully, then consumer (sequential => ~3.2s)
referenceFixes: reference.go launches producer and consumer concurrently (=> ~1.7s)
